expected_behavior: The reproduction is a standalone Node.js script that uses only built-in modules and needs no npm install.
The placeholder block from the template is replaced with the real trigger from the triage brief; an uncustomized template is treated as not done.
The script exits 1 while the bug is present for the bug's own reason, and exits 0 once it is fixed.
The script is small and deterministic, so the same run gives the same result.
